{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for QA orders: look for '999,999.99' with commas
print("Rows with revenue '999,999.99':")
print(sales[sales['revenue'] == '999,999.99'])

# Also check for '999999.99' (no commas) as previously
print("\nRows with revenue '999999.99':")
print(sales[sales['revenue'] == '999999.99'])

# Check if any revenue values have commas
print("\nExamples of revenue with commas:")
print(sales['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False).sum())"}
